art_note: The product photography relies heavily on mockups and flattened templates, reducing the perceived luxury of the garment.
desc_en: A contemporary silhouette defined by clean lines and bold proportions. This crop rugby jersey fuses traditional athletic aesthetics with modern design. Crafted from a lightweight fabric that prioritizes comfort. The V-neckline accentuates its refined structure. A versatile piece designed for the transition between athletic performance and urban style. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta contemporánea definida por líneas limpias y proporciones audaces. Este jersey corto de rugby fusiona la estética deportiva tradicional con un diseño moderno. Confeccionado en un tejido ligero que prioriza el confort. El cuello en V acentúa su estructura depurada. Una prenda versátil diseñada para la transición entre el rendimiento atlético y el estilo urbano. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
details_en:
